items.title_en: High-throughput identification of chromatin-opening transcription factors
items.title_zh: 高通量鉴定染色质开放转录因子
items.abstract_en: Cell fate transitions involve major changes to the chromatin landscape, some of which are thought to deepen the basin around a newly adopted cell state, stabilizing gene expression programs that might otherwise be transient. Transcription factors (TFs) are central to this process, binding only a subset of the genome-wide occurrences of their cognate motifs to create accessible regions that can act as cell type-specific enhancers. However, apart from a few well-studied cases, it is not clear which of the ~1,600 mammalian TFs can directly or indirectly initiate newly accessible sites, nor why only some motif occurrences gain accessibility. Here, we performed pooled CRISPR activation (CRISPRa) screens to upregulate endogenous developmental TFs in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs) and assess their impact on the chromatin landscape. Following a pre-screen of 240 developmental TFs for their capacity to elicit strong changes to the transcriptome, we prioritized 60 TFs for a well-powered CRISPRa multiome screen in which we jointly profiled gene expression and chromatin accessibility across ~140,000 single cells. We identify TFs that appear to initiate new chromatin accessibility on their own ("autonomous"), others whose chromatin-opening activity appears dependent on coincident binding of co-TFs heterogeneously expressed across mESCs ("opportunistic"), and yet others which appear to induce a co-TF and then act alongside it ("hierarchical"). Taken together, our findings suggest that the ability of a TF to "pioneer" chromatin opening, when it is newly expressed at physiological levels, strongly depends on the cell state and gene regulatory network it lands in. Looking forward, a comprehensive charting of such dependencies will inform how cell fate transitions are initiated in development, homeostasis and disease, and how to engineer them in silico, in vitro and in vivo.
items.abstract_zh: 细胞命运转变涉及染色质景观的重大变化，其中一些变化被认为会加深新 adopted 细胞状态周围的吸引盆，稳定原本可能是短暂的基因表达程序。转录因子（TF）在这一过程中处于核心地位，它们只结合其同源基序在全基因组范围内出现的一部分，从而形成可作为细胞类型特异性增强子的可及区域。然而，除少数研究充分的案例外，尚不清楚约 1,600 个哺乳动物 TF 中哪些能够直接或间接启动新出现的可及位点，也不清楚为什么只有部分基序出现位点获得可及性。在这里，我们在小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESC）中进行混合 CRISPR 激活（CRISPRa）筛选，以上调内源性发育 TF，并评估它们对染色质景观的影响。在预先筛选 240 个发育 TF 引发转录组强烈变化的能力之后，我们优先选择 60 个 TF 进行一项具有足够统计效力的 CRISPRa 多组学筛选，在该筛选中我们联合分析了约 140,000 个单细胞的基因表达和染色质可及性。我们鉴定出似乎能够自行启动新染色质可及性的 TF（“自主型”），其染色质开放活性似乎依赖于在 mESC 中异质性表达的共 TF 的同步结合的其他 TF（“机会型”），以及似乎先诱导一个共 TF、随后与其共同作用的其他 TF（“层级型”）。总之，我们的发现表明，当一个 TF 在生理水平上被新表达时，其“开拓”染色质开放的能力强烈依赖于其所处的细胞状态和基因调控网络。展望未来，全面绘制此类依赖性图谱将有助于理解发育、稳态和疾病中细胞命运转变如何被启动，以及如何在计算机、体外和体内对其进行工程化改造。

items.title_en: Evanescent-Depth-Engineered High-Q topological Cavities for Strong Photon-Exciton Coupling
items.title_zh: 用于强光子-激子耦合的倏逝深度工程化高Q拓扑腔
items.abstract_en: Due to the inherent scattering in topological edge states, the topological resonant cavity (TRC) formed by their interference exhibits a relatively low quality factor (Q). To address this issue, we propose the mechanism of engineering the transverse evanescent depth of edge states to achieve high-Q in irregular shaped TRCs, which further enables strong photon-exciton coupling at the single-quantum level. By adjusting the intra- and inter-cell coupling strengths in the pseudo-spin topological photonic crystal, the transverse evanescent depth of edge states is greatly reduced, thereby suppressing the scattering of TRCs. Consequently, the Q of various shaped TRCs with 2 ~ 3 um size is up to 10^5 ~ 10^6 in the visible, so that the strong photon-exciton coupling is achieved. The high-Q topological cavities hold promising application in integrated lasers, sensors, cavity quantum electrodynamics, and quantum photonics.
items.abstract_zh: 由于拓扑边缘态中固有的散射，由其干涉形成的拓扑谐振腔（TRC）表现出相对较低的质量因子（Q）。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种对边缘态的横向倏逝深度进行工程调控的机制，以在形状不规则的 TRC 中实现高 Q，并进一步在单量子级别实现强光子-激子耦合。通过调节赝自旋拓扑光子晶体中的胞内和胞间耦合强度，边缘态的横向倏逝深度被大幅降低，从而抑制 TRC 的散射。因此，尺寸为 2~3 um 的各种形状 TRC 在可见光范围内的 Q 可达 10^5~10^6，从而实现强光子-激子耦合。高 Q 拓扑腔在集成激光器、传感器、腔量子电动力学和量子光子学中具有应用前景。

items.title_en: Towards Multiscale Molecular Representation Learning through Geometry-Based Fragmentation for Polymer Property Prediction
items.title_zh: 面向聚合物性质预测的基于几何碎片化的多尺度分子表示学习
items.abstract_en: It is well established that molecular substructures can contribute unequally to chemical and physical properties, with specific motifs or side chains often playing dominant roles. Fragment-based representations have therefore emerged as an effective strategy for incorporating chemically meaningful inductive biases, as exemplified by molecular fingerprints and fragment-based attention mechanisms. However, many existing fragmentation-based machine learning methods rely on predefined chemical rules, which may yield suboptimal fragmentation for previously unseen or chemically unfamiliar structures and often overlook the importance of multiscale molecular representations. To address these limitations, we formulate molecular fragmentation as a radius-constrained optimization problem inspired by the k-center formulation, where the number of clusters is not fixed a priori but emerges from the specified radius, and propose a geometry-based fragmentation method that partitions arbitrary molecular or material structures using largely geometric information, without relying on predefined chemical fragmentation rules. The method provides flexible control over fragment size, enabling the construction of multiscale fragment representations for scale-adaptive modeling. Building on this framework, we develop a geometric fragment-based attention mechanism that integrates multiscale structural information and incorporate it into a multimodal machine learning model combining p-SMILES representations with three-dimensional (3D) conformational information. Experiments on a benchmark polymer dataset show that incorporating 3D conformational information improves prediction accuracy for several properties over models based exclusively on p-SMILES representations. Explainable artificial intelligence analyses further provide insights into the physical relevance of the learned representations.
items.abstract_zh: 众所周知，分子子结构对化学和物理性质的贡献并不相等，特定基序或侧链往往起主导作用。因此，基于碎片的表示已成为引入具有化学意义的归纳偏置的有效策略，分子指纹和基于碎片的注意力机制就是例证。然而，许多现有的基于碎片化的机器学习方法依赖预定义的化学规则，这可能对以前未见过或化学上不熟悉的结构产生次优碎片化，并且常常忽视多尺度分子表示的重要性。为解决这些局限，我们将分子碎片化表述为一个受半径约束的优化问题，其灵感来自 k-center 形式，其中簇的数量不是先验固定的，而是由指定半径产生；并提出一种基于几何的碎片化方法，该方法主要使用几何信息划分任意分子或材料结构，而不依赖预定义的化学碎片化规则。该方法可灵活控制碎片大小，从而能够构建用于尺度自适应建模的多尺度碎片表示。在此框架基础上，我们开发了一种基于几何碎片的注意力机制，该机制整合多尺度结构信息，并将其纳入一个结合 p-SMILES 表示与三维（3D）构象信息的多模态机器学习模型。在基准聚合物数据集上的实验表明，与仅基于 p-SMILES 表示的模型相比，加入 3D 构象信息提高了若干性质的预测准确率。可解释人工智能分析进一步为所学表示的物理相关性提供了见解。

items.title_en: Overview of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval Task: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers
items.title_zh: NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval 任务概述：科学论文中的跨模态主张验证
items.abstract_en: This paper presents an overview of \emph{SciClaimEval}, a pilot task at NTCIR-19 on verifying scientific claims against the tables and figures of the papers in which they appear. Our dataset pairs authentic claims from 180 papers in machine learning, natural language processing, and medicine with contrastive versions of their tables and figures, one supporting the claim and one minimally modified so that it does not. The task comprises two subtasks: deciding whether a piece of evidence supports a claim, and selecting which of two evidence versions does. Twenty-two teams registered, the highest number among NTCIR-19 tasks, and 14 submitted 177 runs. Most systems built on multimodal large language models, relying on prompting and multi-stage inference rather than task-specific fine-tuning. On the first subtask, the best systems reached 98.1\% pair accuracy, but all six top-ranked systems relied on the contrastive pairs; the best system that judged each claim-evidence pair on its own scored 24.3 points lower. Open-weight models, embedded in carefully designed pipelines, matched proprietary ones. Yet verifying a single claim against its evidence, the setting that matters in practice, remains an open problem.
items.abstract_zh: 本文概述了 SciClaimEval，这是 NTCIR-19 的一个试点任务，旨在依据科学主张所在论文的表格和图形来验证这些主张。我们的数据集将来自机器学习、自然语言处理和医学领域 180 篇论文的真实主张与其表格和图形的对比版本配对，其中一个版本支持该主张，另一个版本经过最小修改使其不支持该主张。该任务包含两个子任务：判断某条证据是否支持一项主张，以及在两个证据版本中选择哪一个支持该主张。共有 22 支团队注册，是 NTCIR-19 任务中注册数量最多的，其中 14 支团队提交了 177 个运行结果。大多数系统构建在多模态大语言模型之上，依赖提示和多阶段推理，而不是任务特定的微调。在第一个子任务上，最佳系统达到 98.1% 的成对准确率，但排名前六的系统都依赖对比对；单独判断每个主张-证据对的最佳系统得分低 24.3 分。嵌入精心设计流程中的开放权重模型与专有模型表现相当。然而，针对其证据验证单一主张——这一在实践中重要的设定——仍然是一个开放问题。

items.title_en: Radio-to-Pose Information for Gauge-Drift Correction in Cooperative Localization
items.title_zh: 用于协同定位中规范漂移校正的无线电到位姿信息
items.abstract_en: Cooperative localization uses odometry and inter-robot measurements to estimate the motion of a robot team. These measurements describe only relative geometry, but the team's estimated position and orientation can drift together over time, i.e., gauge drift. In this work, we study correction of this gauge drift using a radio attenuation map registered in the same world coordinate frame used for robot poses. Specifically, we propose Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts power residuals and their pose derivatives into a Gaussian information matrix and vector pair. RPI builds on the insight that received power is sensitive to shared displacement in the world map. The pose estimator uses the interface together with odometry and inter-robot measurements to update poses and minimize uncertainty. We characterize the shared motions detectable from the map and observed links. For an uncertain shared map, RPI keeps correlations across robots and time and reproduces joint Gaussian pose estimates and covariances. Across $1000$ simulated Gaussian trials, RPI matches the results of joint estimation. Across 32 paired trials with a registered map, RPI reduces common-position RMSE from $0.542$m to $0.140$m in a $50\times50$m arena compared with a baseline that uses radio only to weight relative measurements.
items.abstract_zh: 协同定位使用里程计和机器人间测量来估计机器人团队的运动。这些测量仅描述相对几何关系，但团队估计的位置和姿态可能随时间一起漂移，即规范漂移。在这项工作中，我们研究使用配准到与机器人位姿相同世界坐标系中的无线电衰减图来校正这种规范漂移。具体而言，我们提出无线电到位姿信息（RPI），这是一种将功率残差及其位姿导数转换为高斯信息矩阵和向量对的接口。RPI 基于如下见解：接收功率对世界地图中的共享位移敏感。位姿估计器将该接口与里程计和机器人间测量结合使用，以更新位姿并最小化不确定性。我们刻画了可从地图和观测链路中检测到的共享运动。对于不确定的共享地图，RPI 保持跨机器人和时间的相关性，并再现联合高斯位姿估计和协方差。在 1000 次模拟高斯试验中，RPI 与联合估计的结果一致。在具有配准地图的 32 次配对试验中，与仅使用无线电对相对测量进行加权这一基线相比，RPI 在 50×50 m 的场地中将共同位置 RMSE 从 0.542 m 降低到 0.140 m。

items.title_en: Reviving the Discarded High-Resolution Feature for Transformer-Based Tiny Object Detection
items.title_zh: 复苏被丢弃的高分辨率特征以用于基于Transformer的微小目标检测
items.abstract_en: Tiny object detection remains challenging because tiny instances occupy only a few pixels, and their fine-grained details are easily lost during feature downsampling. Although the highest-resolution feature preserves rich local details for tiny objects, DETR-like detectors often discard it due to its large computational cost, while directly reintroducing this feature also brings dense background noise. To address this problem, we propose ReDHF, a novel framework that Revives the Discarded High-resolution Feature for tiny object detection. ReDHF has three cooperative components. Cross-Scale Deformable Fusion (CSDF) first constructs a semantically enhanced highest-resolution feature and injects its fine-grained details into the shallow feature under a moderate cost. Ellipse-Guided Shallow Supervision (EGSS) then guides the enhanced feature to learn more reliable classification and localization priors by applying geometry-adaptive auxiliary supervision. Full-Scale Query Interaction (FSQI) further enables decoder queries to access both low-level details and high-level semantic information, allowing them to aggregate richer cues for tiny objects. Extensive experiments show that ReDHF consistently improves multiple baselines across different DETR variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the evaluated benchmarks. The best ReDHF variants surpass their baselines by +1.4 AP on AI-TOD-v2, +1.6 AP on VisDrone, and +1.5 AP on SODA-D, with especially notable gains on tiny and small objects.
items.abstract_zh: 微小目标检测仍然具有挑战性，因为微小实例仅占据几个像素，其细粒度细节在特征下采样过程中容易丢失。尽管最高分辨率特征保留了微小目标丰富的局部细节，但类DETR检测器常因其计算开销较大而将其丢弃，而直接重新引入该特征也会带来密集的背景噪声。为解决这一问题，我们提出ReDHF，一个复苏被丢弃的高分辨率特征以用于微小目标检测的新框架。ReDHF包含三个协同组件。跨尺度可变形融合（Cross-Scale Deformable Fusion，CSDF）首先以适度代价构建语义增强的最高分辨率特征，并将其细粒度细节注入浅层特征。随后，椭圆引导的浅层监督（Ellipse-Guided Shallow Supervision，EGSS）通过施加几何自适应辅助监督，引导增强后的特征学习更可靠的分分类与定位先验。全尺度查询交互（Full-Scale Query Interaction，FSQI）进一步使解码器查询能够同时访问低层细节和高层语义信息，从而为微小目标聚合更丰富的线索。大量实验表明，ReDHF在不同DETR变体上持续改进多个基线，并在所评估的基准上达到最先进性能。最佳的ReDHF变体在AI-TOD-v2上超过其基线+1.4 AP，在VisDrone上+1.6 AP，在SODA-D上+1.5 AP，在微小和小目标上增益尤为显著。

items.title_en: Identification of Kinome Biomarkers and Therapeutic Rescue in cGMP-Linked Retinal Degeneration
items.title_zh: cGMP相关视网膜变性中激酶组生物标志物的鉴定与治疗性挽救
items.abstract_en: Inherited retinal degenerations, such as Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP) and Leber's congenital amaurosis (LCA), are major causes of progressive and irreversible vision loss. The large number of genes associated with these disorders makes their clinical and molecular characterization difficult, while systemic biomarkers for disease progression or treatment response remain limited. These challenges were addressed by targeting cGMP-associated mechanisms shared by RP and LCA and integrating systemic biomarker profiling with retinal outcomes. Kinase activity analysis (kinome analysis) in peripheral blood mononuclear cells distinguished healthy and diseased states and captured therapy-associated signatures in rd10 mice treated with LP-CN03, a liposomal formulation of the cGMP analog CN03. This first systemic analysis in a therapeutically responsive animal model highlights kinome analysis as a potential translational readout. Given shared cGMP signaling in RP and AIPL1-associated LCA, LP-CN03's therapeutic potential was further evaluated in a new CRISPR-Cas9-generated Aipl1-/- mouse model. Treatment with LP-CN03 preserved retinal structure and function, as shown by electroretinography, longitudinal optical coherence tomography, fundus imaging, optomotor testing, and photoreceptor-specific gene expression. Together, these findings provide independent in vivo evidence for the neuroprotective effect of LP-CN03 in both cGMP-related RP and LCA, also highlighting the translational value of kinome profiling.
items.abstract_zh: 遗传性视网膜变性，如视网膜色素变性（RP）和Leber先天性黑矇（LCA），是进行性且不可逆视力丧失的主要原因。与这些疾病相关的基因数量众多，使其临床和分子表征困难，而用于疾病进展或治疗反应的系统性生物标志物仍然有限。本研究通过靶向RP和LCA共有的cGMP相关机制，并将系统性生物标志物分析与视网膜结局相结合，来应对这些挑战。外周血单核细胞中的激酶活性分析（激酶组分析）可区分健康与疾病状态，并在接受LP-CN03（cGMP类似物CN03的脂质体制剂）治疗的rd10小鼠中捕获治疗相关特征。这是在一个对治疗有反应的动物模型中首次进行的系统性分析，凸显了激酶组分析作为潜在转化读数的价值。鉴于RP和AIPL1相关LCA共享cGMP信号传导，进一步在新构建的CRISPR-Cas9生成的Aipl1-/-小鼠模型中评估了LP-CN03的治疗潜力。LP-CN03治疗可保持视网膜结构和功能，这由视网膜电图、纵向光学相干断层扫描、眼底成像、视动测试和光感受器特异性基因表达所显示。总之，这些发现为LP-CN03在cGMP相关RP和LCA中的神经保护作用提供了独立的体内证据，同时也凸显了激酶组分析的转化价值。

items.title_en: BIC-Engineered Silicon Nitride Microring Resonators Enabled by an Etch-Free Laser-Writing Approach
items.title_zh: 基于无刻蚀激光直写方法实现的BIC工程氮化硅微环谐振器
items.abstract_en: We report the initial experimental demonstration of a complementary, etch-free approach with fewer fabrication steps, in useful SU-8 ridges written by direct ultraviolet laser lithography on an unpatterned silicon nitride film define waveguides and microring resonators. Because the nitride film is never patterned, scattering at patterned nitride sidewalls does not arise, and the remaining radiative loss is engineered by design. The guided transverse-magnetic mode lies within the continuum of transverse-electric slab modes, and we use bound states in the continuum (BICs) as a design tool to control this radiation. Coupled-mode analysis and full-vectorial simulations show that radiation from the two ridge sidewalls cancels by destructive interference at discrete widths, with a first BIC at 2.25 micron and radiation below 1 dB/cm over a 0.3 micron width window and about 200 nm of bandwidth, and that curvature confines this cancellation to discrete bands of bending radius and width. Laser-written waveguides follow the predicted width dependence of the loss, reaching approximately 1.5 dB/cm near the BIC, where non-radiative loss dominates. A microring designed on a radius-selected BIC band exhibits loaded quality factors up to 1.6 \times 10^4 and, under the over-coupled assignment supported by a coupler model, an intrinsic quality factor of 3.3 \times 10^5. Because radiation is set by a patterned low-index layer on an unetched film, the same approach could be extended to other nanostructures. Optimization of the writing conditions and materials is ongoing.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报道了一种互补的、无刻蚀且制造步骤更少的方法的首次实验演示：在未图案化的氮化硅薄膜上，通过直接紫外激光光刻在可用的SU-8脊形结构中写入波导和微环谐振器。由于氮化物薄膜从未被图案化，因此不会产生图案化氮化物侧壁处的散射，剩余的辐射损耗通过设计进行调控。所导引的横磁模位于横电平板模的连续谱内，我们使用连续谱中的束缚态（BIC）作为设计工具来控制这种辐射。耦合模分析和全矢量模拟表明，来自两个脊形侧壁的辐射在离散宽度处通过相消干涉而抵消，首个BIC位于2.25微米处，在0.3微米宽度窗口和约200 nm带宽内辐射低于1 dB/cm，并且曲率将该抵消限制在弯曲半径和宽度的离散带内。激光写入波导的损耗随宽度变化与预测一致，在BIC附近达到约1.5 dB/cm，此时非辐射损耗占主导。在设计于半径选定BIC带上的微环中，加载品质因数最高达1.6 × 10^4，并且在耦合器模型支持的过耦合归属下，本征品质因数为3.3 × 10^5。由于辐射由未刻蚀薄膜上图案化的低折射率层设定，相同方法可扩展到其他纳米结构。写入条件和材料的优化正在进行中。

items.title_en: DictLLM: Post-training Compression of Large Language Model with Dictionary Kernels
items.title_zh: DictLLM：使用字典核的大语言模型训练后压缩
items.abstract_en: Efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices requires balancing performance with compute and memory constraints. Post-training compression is an effective approach to managing this trade-off, while requiring much less computation than in-training counterparts. We propose DictLLM, a dictionary-based compression scheme in which weight matrices within grouped layers are decomposed into a shared dictionary and layer-specific sparse coefficients, directly obtained from a pre-trained model without further training. Specifically, we cast DictLLM as a four-step post-training optimization. First, we obtain shared dictionaries via singular value decomposition (SVD) of input-scaled weight matrices, amortizing rank across grouped layers; second, we sparsify the layer-specific coefficients to the target compression ratio using a dictionary-aware Hessian; and third, we refine the dictionaries given the resulting sparse coefficients. Finally, we aggressively quantize both components using factor-specific Hessian information: input covariance for the dictionaries and the dictionary-aware Hessian for the coefficients. The resulting representation reduces memory footprint by storing a single shared dictionary per layer group, along with sparse layer-specific coefficients. On language modeling and zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, DictLLM consistently outperforms existing post-training low-rank compression methods and pushes the Pareto frontier between model size and performance. DictLLM compresses the original LLaMA-7B model by 5.1x with only a 2.9-point increase in WikiText-2 perplexity, achieving a 3.6x higher compression ratio than the state-of-the-art low-rank method.
items.abstract_zh: 在移动设备上高效部署大语言模型（LLM）需要在性能与计算和内存约束之间取得平衡。训练后压缩是管理这一权衡的有效方法，同时所需计算量远少于训练中压缩方法。我们提出DictLLM，一种基于字典的压缩方案，其中分组层内的权重矩阵被分解为共享字典和层特定稀疏系数，直接从预训练模型获得而无需进一步训练。具体而言，我们将DictLLM构建为一个四步训练后优化。首先，通过对输入缩放后的权重矩阵进行奇异值分解（SVD）获得共享字典，在分组层之间摊销秩；其次，使用字典感知的Hessian将层特定系数稀疏化到目标压缩比；第三，根据所得的稀疏系数细化字典。最后，我们使用因子特定的Hessian信息对两个组件进行激进量化：对字典使用输入协方差，对系数使用字典感知的Hessian。所得表示通过为每个层组存储单个共享字典以及稀疏的层特定系数来减少内存占用。在语言建模和零样本推理基准上，DictLLM始终优于现有的训练后低秩压缩方法，并推进了模型大小与性能之间的帕累托前沿。DictLLM将原始LLaMA-7B模型压缩5.1倍，WikiText-2困惑度仅增加2.9点，压缩比是最先进低秩方法的3.6倍。

items.title_en: Robots in the City: Persona-Based Perceptions of Urban Robots
items.title_zh: 城市中的机器人：基于人格化设定的城市机器人感知
items.abstract_en: Pedestrians increasingly encounter robots in urban public spaces without interacting with them, but how robots change the perceived safety of a street remains unclear. We examine how robot presence and type affect perceived safety across urban contexts. We generate 18 images of Seoul streets that vary in time of day, road class, and robot condition (no robot, a delivery robot, or a humanoid). Two multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma4-26B, each conditioned on 500 synthetic personas, choose the safer image in each pair, and 25 human respondents complete the same task. Both models prefer streets without robots and favor the delivery robot over the humanoid. Robots are chosen more often at night and less often by older personas, whereas road class has smaller effects. In the model rationales, the delivery robot appears as a physical obstacle, whereas the humanoid appears as either a threat or a source of protection. Like humans, both models chose robots more often at night, but chose the humanoid over the delivery robot far less often, and Gemma showed a night effect for the humanoid about three times that of humans. These results show that the effect of a robot on perceived safety depends on when it appears, and that persona-conditioned MLLMs capture only part of human judgments.
items.abstract_zh: 行人越来越多地在城市公共空间中遇到机器人而并不与其交互，但机器人如何改变街道的安全感知仍不清楚。我们考察机器人存在与否及机器人类型如何在不同城市场景中影响安全感知。我们生成18张首尔街道图像，这些图像在一天中的时段、道路等级和机器人条件（无机器人、配送机器人或人形机器人）上有所不同。两个多模态大语言模型（MLLM），Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma4-26B，分别以500个合成人格设定为条件，在每对图像中选择更安全的图像，25名人类受访者完成相同任务。两个模型都偏好没有机器人的街道，并且偏好配送机器人胜过人形机器人。机器人在夜间被选择的频率更高，而年龄较大的人格设定选择机器人的频率更低，道路等级的影响较小。在模型给出的理由中，配送机器人表现为物理障碍物，而人形机器人则表现为威胁或保护来源。与人类一样，两个模型在夜间更常选择机器人，但选择人形机器人胜过配送机器人的频率远低于人类，且Gemma对人形机器人表现出的夜间效应约为人类的三倍。这些结果表明，机器人对安全感知的影响取决于其出现的时间，并且人格条件化的MLLM仅捕获了人类判断的一部分。

items.title_en: An Integrated Open-Source Stack for Vision-Based Autonomous Navigation of Wheeled Rovers
items.title_zh: 用于轮式漫游车视觉自主导航的集成开源技术栈
items.abstract_en: Vision-based rover autonomy requires integrating perception, localization, planning and platform-specific control under limited sensing and computing resources. We present an open-source ROS 2 stack for following directional arrows, reaching a terminal cone and returning autonomously to the start. It connects YOLOv8n detection and geometric direction, range and bearing estimation with RGB-D SLAM, wheel-inertial state estimation, kinematics-aware planning, behavior-tree mission management and STM32 actuation. Standard interfaces separate reusable autonomy from the hardware layer; a proportional path-following plugin supports low-speed rover motion. Public resources include software, configuration, a labeled dataset, trained weights and evaluation logs. On 478 held-out images, the detector achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.720 under the Ultralytics evaluator and outperforms a classical OpenCV baseline under a shared evaluation protocol. The reported perception latency is 25 ms on a Jetson Orin NX. Three missions, one indoor and two outdoor, demonstrate marker-guided navigation and autonomous return without operator motion commands or reported collisions. Field results document integration failures and corrective choices; repeated instrumented trials remain necessary to quantify physical navigation errors and reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的漫游车自主性需要在有限的传感和计算资源下集成感知、定位、规划和平台特定控制。我们提出一个开源ROS 2技术栈，用于跟随方向箭头、到达终端锥桶并自主返回起点。它将YOLOv8n检测与几何方向、距离和方位估计与RGB-D SLAM、轮式惯性状态估计、运动学感知规划、行为树任务管理和STM32执行相连。标准接口将可复用自主性与硬件层分离；一个比例路径跟随插件支持低速漫游车运动。公开资源包括软件、配置、标注数据集、训练权重和评估日志。在478张留出图像上，检测器在Ultralytics评估器下达到mAP@0.5为0.720，并在共享评估协议下优于经典OpenCV基线。报告的感知延迟在Jetson Orin NX上为25 ms。三次任务（一次室内、两次室外）展示了标记引导导航和自主返回，无需操作员运动指令且未报告碰撞。现场结果记录了集成失败和纠正选择；仍需要重复的仪器化试验来量化物理导航误差和可靠性。

items.title_en: InnerLogic-Surg: An Open Surgical Foundation Model via Continual Pretraining
items.title_zh: InnerLogic-Surg：一种通过持续预训练构建的开放式外科基础模型
items.abstract_en: Vision foundation models are the backbone of modern surgical image analysis, yet most surgical systems still rely on encoders pretrained on natural images or on specialist models trained from scratch on comparatively small datasets. Pretraining encoders on large amounts of surgery-specific data has the potential to generally enhance the performance of surgical image analysis methods simply by providing stronger backbones. Here we present InnerLogic-Surg, an open family of surgical vision encoders (21M--300M parameters) obtained by continually pretraining a transformer-based image encoder on millions of surgical images curated from 11,965 internet-sourced surgical videos spanning ~2,900 hours and more than fifteen procedure types. Our training recipe inherits DINOv3's pretraining stage to preserve representation ability after surgical adaptation, and additionally applies a learned feature-upsampling module for high-resolution dense prediction at low token cost. Across a benchmark covering workflow, instrument and anatomy recognition, segmentation, detection, and monocular depth, under the same architecture, the largest InnerLogic-Surg model achieves the best linear-probe performance in all 20 surgical tasks. We demonstrate that surgical continual pretraining yields transferable representations that generalize across procedures, anatomical regions, and task types, showing our surgical image encoders as a promising and scalable alternative to the procedure-specific representation learning approaches that have traditionally dominated surgical computer vision.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉基础模型是现代外科图像分析的骨干，然而大多数外科系统仍依赖在自然图像上预训练的编码器，或在相对较小的数据集上从头训练的专业模型。在大规模外科专用数据上预训练编码器，有可能仅通过提供更强的骨干网络来普遍提升外科图像分析方法的性能。在此，我们提出 InnerLogic-Surg，一个开放式外科视觉编码器系列（21M–300M 参数），其通过从 11,965 个互联网来源的外科视频中整理出的数百万张外科图像进行持续预训练而获得，这些视频跨度约 2,900 小时、涵盖超过十五种手术类型。我们的训练方案继承 DINOv3 的预训练阶段，以在外科适应后保留表示能力，并额外应用一个学习到的特征上采样模块，以低 token 成本实现高分辨率密集预测。在一个涵盖工作流、器械与解剖识别、分割、检测和单目深度的基准上，在相同架构下，最大的 InnerLogic-Surg 模型在所有 20 项外科任务中取得最佳线性探测性能。我们证明，外科持续预训练产生可迁移的表示，能够跨手术类型、解剖区域和任务类型泛化，表明我们的外科图像编码器是传统上主导外科计算机视觉的特定手术表示学习方法的一种有前景且可扩展的替代方案。

items.title_en: Global Proteomic Analysis of Colorectal Cancers Stratified by Microsatellite Instability Subtype Reveals Protein Differences
items.title_zh: 按微卫星不稳定亚型分层的结直肠癌全局蛋白质组分析揭示蛋白质差异
items.abstract_en: Lynch syndrome, historically known as hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer, is caused by germline mutations in the DNA mismatch repair (MMR) genes, MLH1, MSH2 (EPCAM), MSH6, and PMS2. While the genetic changes associated with Lynch syndrome have previously been characterized, there have not been studies of the associated proteomic alterations, in part because of the limited availability of primary samples and the absence of in vitro model systems. In this study, the first large-scale tissue proteomic assessment of Lynch syndrome samples as well as three other subtypes of colorectal cancer was completed with specimens from the Ohio Colorectal Cancer Prevention Initiative. The cohort contained three groups of microsatellite unstable (MSI-high) colorectal cancer (CRC) patients (Lynch syndrome, double somatic MMR mutation, and MLH1 hypermethylation) and a group of microsatellite stable (MSS) CRC patients. A total of 122 tumor and complimentary normal mucosa samples from 61 patients were evaluated using label-free bottom-up proteomic analysis identifying 7,352 proteins. Hierarchical clustering analysis of the global proteome showed that the MSS group was significantly different than the three MSI-high groups. Of the 1,607 proteins found to be dysregulated within CRC patients, 648 proteins were specific to Lynch syndrome and 260 proteins were dysregulated across all four subtypes studied. Further examination of dysregulated proteins in response to age of diagnosis and patient's sex assigned at birth were also evaluated. This study fills a critical gap as the first proteomic characterization of Lynch syndrome samples to date. Data are available via ProteomeXchange with identifier PXD073693.
items.abstract_zh: Lynch 综合征，历史上称为遗传性非息肉病性结直肠癌，由 DNA 错配修复（MMR）基因 MLH1、MSH2（EPCAM）、MSH6 和 PMS2 的胚系突变引起。虽然 Lynch 综合征相关的遗传改变此前已被表征，但尚无相关蛋白质组改变的研究，部分原因是原代样本可获得性有限以及缺乏体外模型系统。在本研究中，利用来自俄亥俄州结直肠癌预防计划的标本，完成了首个针对 Lynch 综合征样本以及其他三种结直肠癌亚型的大规模组织蛋白质组评估。该队列包含三组微卫星不稳定（MSI-high）结直肠癌（CRC）患者（Lynch 综合征、双体细胞 MMR 突变和 MLH1 高甲基化）以及一组微卫星稳定（MSS）CRC 患者。使用无标记自下而上蛋白质组分析评估了来自 61 名患者的 122 份肿瘤及配对正常黏膜样本，鉴定出 7,352 种蛋白质。全局蛋白质组的层次聚类分析显示，MSS 组与三个 MSI-high 组显著不同。在 CRC 患者中发现失调的 1,607 种蛋白质中，648 种为 Lynch 综合征特异性，260 种在所研究的全部四种亚型中均失调。进一步考察了失调蛋白质与诊断年龄和患者出生时指定性别的关系。本研究填补了一个关键空白，是迄今为止首个 Lynch 综合征样本的蛋白质组表征。数据可通过 ProteomeXchange 获取，标识符为 PXD073693。

items.title_en: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
items.title_zh: 解读原因：在光和量子比特上具有精确词证据的玻恩测量注意力
items.abstract_en: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to $10^{-11}$ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches $76.98 \pm 0.17$% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size ($76.62 \pm 0.36$%). Deleting the word its evidence ranks first changes the answer in 45% of test pairs, out of the 53% any single deletion can change, against 32% for the softmax model explained the same way and 40% by its attention x gradient. Attention can look as much like the words annotators highlighted as the evidence does, yet accounts for the answer less well: deleting the word it ranks first changes the Born Transformer's answer in 32% of pairs. The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic optics and to qubits, and a coherent attention layer becomes one circuit equal to the model (852 CNOTs on 23 qubits). On IBM's ibm_kingston, reading only the attention overlaps by Hadamard tests, the device gave the model's answers, also when a word was deleted. With calibration circuits as deep as the overlaps, each word's evidence with the device's attention row sums followed the exact evidence (correlations 0.997 and 0.932 on two pairs chosen in advance); where a pair's evidence is a small total of large opposite terms the earlier runs say it does not, and we say why.
items.abstract_zh: 当语言模型给出答案时，我们通常只能估计其原因。我们构建了一个 transformer，其中每一步都是玻恩测量——注意力 $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ 在每一行上归一化，用一个测量乘积代替前馈非线性，以及一个玻恩读出。将其分母保持为输入时的值，每个类概率都是词振幅的多项式，因此其积分梯度证据通过有限求积计算且无求积误差：各词的贡献之和等于类概率高于其无信息份额的部分，达到 $10^{-11}$ 或更好。在 e-SNLI 自然语言推理上，在嵌入之外约有 98k 参数，模型达到 $76.98 \pm 0.17$% 的测试准确率，与相同大小的 softmax transformer 相当（$76.62 \pm 0.36$%）。删除其证据排名第一的词，在 45% 的测试对中改变答案，而在任何单次删除可改变的 53% 中；相比之下，以相同方式解释的 softmax 模型为 32%，其注意力×梯度为 40%。注意力可以看起来与证据一样像标注者高亮的词，但对答案的解释较差：删除其排名第一的词，在 32% 的对中改变玻恩 Transformer 的答案。相同的权重可精确编译为光电子光学和量子比特，一个相干注意力层成为一个等同于模型的电路（23 个量子比特上的 852 个 CNOT）。在 IBM 的 ibm_kingston 上，仅通过 Hadamard 测试读取注意力重叠，该设备给出了模型的答案，在删除一个词时也是如此。使用与重叠一样深的校准电路，每个词的证据结合设备的注意力行和遵循精确证据（在预先选定的两对上相关性为 0.997 和 0.932）；当一对的证据是大的相反项的小总和时，早期运行表明并非如此，我们说明了原因。

items.title_en: Spectral symmetry fingerprints in equivariant representations
items.title_zh: 等变表示中的谱对称指纹
items.abstract_en: Symmetry governs the organization of physical structures, while symmetry breaking reveals their transformations. In geometric deep learning, symmetry imposes rank constraints on equivariant representations, limiting the expressive capacity of equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs). Here we show that these constraints can instead be exploited: the singular-value spectra of equivariant representations provide a unified fingerprint of structural symmetry. We introduce spectral symmetry fingerprints (SymFP), which enable discrete point-group identification through rank-template matching and continuous symmetry analysis by quantifying spectral energy beyond target rank constraints. SymFP is orientation invariant and architecture agnostic, enabling a parameter-free GNN implementation. Its spectra can be reused across multiple target groups, and the resulting leakage scores satisfy subgroup monotonicity. Across synthetic structures, molecules, coordination complexes and large biological assemblies, SymFP accurately identifies point groups, tracks controlled symmetry breaking and reveals local and degree-resolved symmetry changes that can be obscured by global geometric measures. These results establish the spectral structure of equivariant representations as a general framework for characterizing symmetry across physical systems.
items.abstract_zh: 对称性支配物理结构的组织，而对称性破缺揭示其变换。在几何深度学习中，对称性对等变表示施加秩约束，限制了等变图神经网络（GNN）的表达能力。在此我们表明，这些约束反而可以被利用：等变表示的奇异值谱提供了结构对称性的统一指纹。我们引入谱对称指纹（SymFP），其能够通过秩模板匹配进行离散点群识别，并通过量化超出目标秩约束的谱能量进行连续对称性分析。SymFP 具有方向不变性且与架构无关，可实现无参数的 GNN 实现。其谱可跨多个目标群重用，且所得泄漏分数满足子群单调性。在合成结构、分子、配位配合物和大型生物组装体上，SymFP 准确识别点群，跟踪受控对称性破缺，并揭示可能被全局几何度量掩盖的局部和按度分辨的对称性变化。这些结果确立了等变表示的谱结构作为表征跨物理系统对称性的通用框架。

items.title_en: TraceRouter++: Causal Semantic Routing Realignment via Optimal Transport
items.title_zh: TraceRouter++：通过最优传输的因果语义路由重对齐
items.abstract_en: Despite their remarkable capabilities, large foundation models (LFMs) remain susceptible to adversarial manipulation. Current safety intervention methods primarily rely on the \textit{locality hypothesis}, rigidly suppressing isolated neurons or features. However, harmful semantics manifest as distributed, cross-layer circuits, rendering localized ablations both brittle against complex jailbreaks and detrimental to general utility. To bridge this gap, we propose TraceRouter++, a routing-level safety intervention framework that explicitly traces safety-relevant causal routing pathways activated under harmful inputs and realigns their unsafe activation states. Our framework operates in a \textit{Discover-Trace-Realign} paradigm: it first pinpoints a sensitive onset layer via attention divergence and disentangles dense activations into interpretable routing features using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). Subsequently, it maps these features to downstream causal circuits via feature influence scores (FIS). Crucially, departing from rigid suppression paradigms, TraceRouter++ introduces a constrained optimal transport (OT)-based soft routing realignment. By formulating safety intervention as a tractable coordinate-wise marginal optimal transport approximation, our method redirects unsafe activation marginals toward safe-reference marginals within causally identified routing subspaces while preserving non-selected coordinates at the intervention point. This mechanism safely redirects malicious semantic flows while leaving orthogonal computational routes intact. Extensive experiments across representative large language models (LLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and diffusion models (DMs) show that TraceRouter++ outperforms evaluated baselines, improving adversarial robustness while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. WARNING: This paper contains unsafe model responses.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大型基础模型（LFM）具有显著能力，它们仍然容易受到对抗性操纵。当前的安全干预方法主要依赖局部性假设，僵硬地抑制孤立神经元或特征。然而，有害语义表现为分布式跨层电路，使得局部消融既对复杂越狱脆弱，又有损通用效用。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 TraceRouter++，一种路由级安全干预框架，其显式追踪在有害输入下激活的安全相关因果路由路径，并重对齐其不安全激活状态。我们的框架在“发现-追踪-重对齐”范式下运行：首先通过注意力散度定位敏感起始层，并使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将密集激活解耦为可解释的路由特征。随后，它通过特征影响分数（FIS）将这些特征映射到下游因果电路。关键的是，TraceRouter++ 偏离刚性抑制范式，引入基于约束最优传输（OT）的软路由重对齐。通过将安全干预表述为可处理的逐坐标边际最优传输近似，我们的方法在因果识别的路由子空间内将不安全激活边际重定向至安全参考边际，同时在干预点保留未选坐标。该机制安全地重定向恶意语义流，同时保持正交计算路径不变。在代表性大型语言模型（LLM）、多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）和扩散模型（DM）上的大量实验表明，TraceRouter++ 优于评估的基线，在提高对抗鲁棒性的同时保持有利的安全-效用权衡。警告：本文包含不安全的模型响应。

items.title_en: Unified Overview of Safety Certificate Functions: Techniques from Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability and Control Barrier Functions
items.title_zh: 安全证书函数的统一概述：来自 Hamilton–Jacobi 可达性与控制屏障函数的技术
items.abstract_en: Safety is a central concern in modern autonomous systems. Safety certificates---functions whose existence guarantees that a system meets its safety specification---have long been used as a principled tool for rigorously reasoning about safety. Methods for synthesizing such certificates are scattered across research areas, with little guidance on when to use a particular approach. This tutorial provides a holistic treatment of safety certificate synthesis centered on two widely used families: Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis and control barrier functions (CBFs). For each family of methods, we first introduce its general formulation, along with classical and learning-based tools for certificate synthesis. Next, we introduce two benchmark problems consisting of vehicle systems of differing complexity to assess the certificate quality of different synthesis methods and their effectiveness in safety-critical control. We use these benchmarks to compare various methods and provide practical guidance for selecting an approach.
items.abstract_zh: 安全是现代自主系统的核心关切。安全证书——其存在保证系统满足其安全规范的函数——长期以来一直被用作严格推理安全的原则性工具。用于合成此类证书的方法分散在不同研究领域，关于何时使用特定方法的指导很少。本教程以两个广泛使用的方法家族为中心，对安全证书合成进行全面处理：Hamilton–Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析和控制屏障函数（CBF）。对于每个方法家族，我们首先介绍其一般形式，以及用于证书合成的经典和基于学习的工具。接下来，我们介绍两个由不同复杂度车辆系统组成的基准问题，以评估不同合成方法的证书质量及其在安全关键控制中的有效性。我们使用这些基准比较各种方法，并为选择方法提供实用指导。

items.title_en: FlyingDrones: A Dataset and Benchmark for Optical Flow Estimation from UAV motion
items.title_zh: FlyingDrones：一个用于无人机运动光流估计的数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Optical flow is an important cue for drone analysis in aerial surveillance, airspace monitoring, and long-range target tracking, where motion remains informative when appearance is weak. Estimating the motion of small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, however, is difficult because distant targets occupy few pixels, have low contrast, and move against complex dynamic backgrounds. Standard optical-flow benchmarks emphasize large, object-centric motions and therefore do not characterize distant aerial targets well. We introduce FlyingDrones, a generated benchmark with dense ground-truth optical flow and segmentation masks derived from physically based rendering, and define resolution-normalized metrics (EPE Norm) that normalize flow by image dimensions. We evaluate 16 state-of-the-art model families on a motion- and size-stratified subset of 999 flow pairs at three resolutions. Every family recovers drone motion better than the zero-flow reference, but the gap between families widens with resolution: at 1920x1080, global-matching, recurrent, transformer, and short-window temporal models separate clearly from pyramid, classical, self-supervised, lightweight, and diffusion models. Within-family checkpoint spread is comparable to or larger than between-family spread, so the training curriculum is as important as the architecture. Two complementary studies test the benchmark beyond synthetic accuracy: a ground-truth-free motion-alignment evaluation on 21 cameras of real UAV footage shows that the synthetic ranking carries a moderate, significant signal about real-world performance (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.63 over 41 checkpoints) while the exact top ranks differ, and a fine-tuning study shows that 800 FlyingDrones pairs reduce held-out drone-region error by up to 37% and improve drone localization on the real footage for all four architectures tested.
items.abstract_zh: 光流是空中监视、空域监控和远距离目标跟踪中无人机分析的重要线索，在这些场景中，当外观特征较弱时运动信息仍然具有信息量。然而，估计小型无人机的运动是困难的，因为远处目标仅占据少量像素、对比度低，并且在复杂的动态背景中运动。标准光流基准强调大型的、以物体为中心的运动，因此不能很好地刻画远处的空中目标。我们提出 FlyingDrones，一个生成的基准，具有由基于物理的渲染得到的密集真值光流和分割掩码，并定义了按图像尺寸对光流进行归一化的分辨率归一化指标（EPE Norm）。我们在三个分辨率下、按运动和尺寸分层抽取的 999 个光流对子集上评估了 16 个最先进的模型家族。每个模型家族在恢复无人机运动方面都优于零光流参考，但家族之间的差距随分辨率增大而扩大：在 1920x1080 下，全局匹配、循环、Transformer 和短窗口时序模型与金字塔、经典、自监督、轻量级和扩散模型明显区分开来。家族内检查点差异与家族间差异相当或更大，因此训练课程与架构同样重要。两项互补研究在合成精度之外测试该基准：在真实无人机影像的 21 个摄像头上进行的无真值运动对齐评估表明，合成排名对真实世界性能携带中等且显著的信号（在 41 个检查点上 Spearman ρ = 0.63），而具体的前列排名有所不同；一项微调研究表明，800 个 FlyingDrones 光流对可将留出的无人机区域误差降低最多 37%，并在所有四种测试架构上改善真实影像中的无人机定位。

items.title_en: Diagnostic Value in Discarded Reads: Re-evaluating Multi-Mapping cfDNA Fragmentomics and GC Bias in Early-Stage Cancer.
items.title_zh: 被丢弃读段中的诊断价值：重新评估早期癌症中的多映射 cfDNA 片段组学与 GC 偏倚
items.abstract_en: Background. Low-coverage plasma cell-free DNA (cfDNA) sequencing is an inexpensive substrate for cancer detection. Standard pipelines discard fragments with low mapping quality, which originate mostly from repetitive DNA, although pericentromeric satellite repeats are frequently hypomethylated in cancer. We asked whether the fraction of multi-mapping cfDNA fragments differs between early-stage cancer and matched healthy controls, and how it compares with conventional fragmentomic features under strict control of technical factors. Methods. We analysed public plasma cfDNA whole-genome sequencing from 25 patients with stage I to III breast cancer and 25 healthy controls matched 1:1 for age, sex, smoking and alcohol use, each pair processed in the same library and sequencing batch, and from 8 early-stage hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cases with 8 matched controls. For every sample we computed the fraction of autosomal fragments with MAPQ < 30 and the share of these fragments located in centromeric and heterochromatic cytobands, and related them to stage, grade and copy-number deviation as proxies of tumour burden. Classifiers were evaluated by leave-one-pair-out cross-validation in breast cancer and, trained on breast cancer only, applied unchanged to HCC. Robustness to GC content and sequencing depth was tested by within-fold residualisation and by fragment-level GC weighting. Conventional fragmentomic features (fragment length, end motifs, copy number, DELFI-like profiles and window features at transcription start sites) were evaluated under four GC-handling analyses. Results. The multi-mapping fraction was higher in breast cancer than in matched controls (median 5.38 % vs 5.19 %; higher in 19/25 pairs; paired p = 0.0006; cross-validated AUC 0.81, 95 % CI 0.67 - 0.94), in stage I (9/10 pairs), stage II (7/10) and stage III (3/5) disease and in every sequencing batch. The excess was concentrated in centromeric and heterochromatic bands, whose share of multi-mapping fragments rose from 22.0 % to 23.4 % (19/25 pairs; p = 0.004). Both signals persisted after within-fold adjustment for GC content and/or depth (AUC 0.64 - 0.76 for the multi-mapping fraction, 0.71 - 0.76 for the heterochromatic share) and under fragment-level GC weighting (18/25 pairs; p = 0.003). The multi-mapping difference was largest in stage I and decreased with stage (Spearman {rho} = -0.42, p = 0.04), and neither feature was associated with grade or copy-number deviation. In public tissue methylomes, satellites were hypomethylated in breast tumours to a similar extent as other late-replicating DNA, but the bin-level association between tumour hypomethylation and the cfDNA excess was weak and was explained by GC content. In HCC, the pre-specified endpoint, the breast-trained multi-mapping model, was not met (AUC 0.73; 5/8 pairs; sign test p = 0.36). In an exploratory analysis that was not pre-specified, the heterochromatic share was higher in 7/8 HCC pairs (p = 0.016; locked AUC 0.86, 95 % CI 0.62 - 1.00); across all 33 pairs, including the discovery pairs, it was higher in the cancer case in 26 (post hoc sign test p = 0.0007). In contrast, conventional fragmentomic features reached AUC 0.71 (breast) and 0.77 (HCC) only without fragment-level GC control; they tracked the per-sample coverage GC dependence and fell to chance under each of three GC-controlled analyses, including one that preserves promoter-specific signal. Conclusions. Multi-mapping cfDNA fragments, which are routinely discarded, differed between early-stage breast cancer and batch-matched controls, largely independently of GC content and sequencing depth, with an excess in centromeric and heterochromatic DNA. The signal did not scale with stage, its biological origin is unproven, and a read-quality contribution cannot be excluded from fragment files. It is a candidate marker that requires confirmation in larger cohorts with raw reads and tumour-fraction estimates.
items.abstract_zh: 背景。低覆盖度血浆游离 DNA（cfDNA）测序是癌症检测的一种廉价底物。标准流程会丢弃映射质量低的片段，这些片段主要来自重复 DNA，尽管近着丝粒卫星重复序列在癌症中经常低甲基化。我们探究多映射 cfDNA 片段的比例在早期癌症与匹配健康对照之间是否存在差异，以及在严格控制技术因素的条件下，它与传统片段组学特征相比如何。方法。我们分析了公开血浆 cfDNA 全基因组测序数据，包括 25 例 I 至 III 期乳腺癌患者和 25 名按年龄、性别、吸烟和饮酒 1:1 匹配的健康对照（每对在同一文库和测序批次中处理），以及 8 例早期肝细胞癌（HCC）病例和 8 名匹配对照。对每个样本，我们计算 MAPQ < 30 的常染色体片段比例，以及这些片段位于着丝粒和异染色质细胞带中的份额，并将其与分期、分级和拷贝数偏差（作为肿瘤负荷的代理）相关联。分类器在乳腺癌中采用留一对交叉验证评估，并且仅在乳腺癌上训练后原样应用于 HCC。通过折内残差化和片段级 GC 加权测试对 GC 含量和测序深度的稳健性。传统片段组学特征（片段长度、末端基序、拷贝数、类 DELFI 谱以及转录起始位点窗口特征）在四种 GC 处理分析下进行评估。结果。多映射片段比例在乳腺癌中高于匹配对照（中位数 5.38% 对 5.19%；19/25 对中更高；配对 p = 0.0006；交叉验证 AUC 0.81，95% CI 0.67–0.94），在 I 期（9/10 对）、II 期（7/10）、III 期（3/5）疾病中以及每个测序批次中均如此。该超量集中在着丝粒和异染色质带，这些带中多映射片段的份额从 22.0% 升至 23.4%（19/25 对；p = 0.004）。两个信号在折内校正 GC 含量和/或深度后（多映射片段比例 AUC 0.64–0.76，异染色质份额 0.71–0.76）以及在片段级 GC 加权下（18/25 对；p = 0.003）均持续存在。多映射差异在 I 期最大并随分期下降（Spearman ρ = -0.42，p = 0.04），且两个特征均与分级或拷贝数偏差无关。在公开组织甲基化组中，卫星序列在乳腺肿瘤中的低甲基化程度与其他晚复制 DNA 相似，但肿瘤低甲基化与 cfDNA 超量之间的分箱水平关联较弱，且可由 GC 含量解释。在 HCC 中，未达到预先设定的终点，即乳腺癌训练的多映射模型（AUC 0.73；5/8 对；符号检验 p = 0.36）。在未预先设定的探索性分析中，异染色质份额在 7/8 个 HCC 对中更高（p = 0.016；锁定 AUC 0.86，95% CI 0.62–1.00）；在包括发现对在内的所有 33 对中，癌症病例中有 26 对更高（事后符号检验 p = 0.0007）。相比之下，传统片段组学特征仅在没有片段级 GC 控制时达到 AUC 0.71（乳腺）和 0.77（HCC）；它们跟随每样本覆盖度的 GC 依赖性，并在三种 GC 控制分析中的每一种下都降至随机水平，其中一种分析保留了启动子特异性信号。结论。常规被丢弃的多映射 cfDNA 片段在早期乳腺癌与批次匹配对照之间存在差异，且在很大程度上独立于 GC 含量和测序深度，并在着丝粒和异染色质 DNA 中呈现超量。该信号不随分期变化，其生物学来源尚未证实，且不能从片段文件中排除读段质量的贡献。它是一个候选标志物，需要在具有原始读段和肿瘤分数估计的更大队列中确认。

items.title_en: Noise-Induced Topology in Chiral Quantum Walks
items.title_zh: 手性量子行走中的噪声诱导拓扑
items.abstract_en: Noise typically destroys quantum coherence and washes out transport phenomena that rely on interference. Chiral quantum walks are a case in point: a particle hopping on a lattice threaded by a magnetic flux can spread asymmetrically due to interference between paths, an asymmetry that noise is expected to erase. Remarkably, we find that the most ubiquitous noise -- random fluctuations of on-site energies (dephasing) -- instead renders this asymmetry topologically robust. The density profile develops a skewness that grows in time while its center stays fixed, and in a finite chain the late-time relaxation modes pile up at one edge: a skin effect lacking the drift of conventional non-Hermitian skin effects. With multiple sites per unit cell, the dephasing strength alone can cause a topological phase transition, reversing the asymmetry. On a flux ladder with noisy rung hopping, the noise causes a drift of rung coherences, a quantum ratchet with no classical counterpart. Underlying these effects, the noise-averaged dynamics is an interacting (generically non-integrable) Lindbladian that remains analytically tractable. The modes governing late-time relaxation are bound states of the noise-induced interaction and form a band with a point gap, absent both without noise and under postselection, whose winding number fixes the direction of the asymmetry. These effects are within reach of several experimental platforms, including synthetic lattices, superconducting qubits, and optical lattices.
items.abstract_zh: 噪声通常会破坏量子相干性，并冲刷掉依赖干涉的输运现象。手性量子行走是一个典型例子：粒子在贯穿磁通的晶格上跃迁时，由于路径之间的干涉，可以不对称地扩散，而这种不对称性预计会被噪声抹去。值得注意的是，我们发现最常见的噪声——在位能的随机涨落（退相位）——反而使这种不对称性在拓扑上稳健。密度分布会产生随时间增长而中心保持固定的偏度，并且在有限链中，晚期弛豫模式堆积在一侧边缘：这是一种缺乏传统非厄米趋肤效应漂移的趋肤效应。当每个晶胞有多个位点时，仅退相位强度就能导致拓扑相变，逆转不对称性。在具有噪声横档跃迁的通量梯中，噪声导致横档相干性的漂移，这是一种没有经典对应物的量子棘轮。这些效应背后，噪声平均后的动力学是一个相互作用（通常不可积）的 Lindbladian，且仍可解析处理。控制晚期弛豫的模式是噪声诱导相互作用的束缚态，并形成具有点隙的能带；该点隙在无噪声时和后选择下均不存在，其绕数决定不对称性的方向。这些效应在若干实验平台上可及，包括合成晶格、超导量子比特和光晶格。

items.title_en: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
items.title_zh: 卵巢癌多组学数据集合成：一个生物学信息驱动的评估框架
items.abstract_en: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.
items.abstract_zh: 配对的癌症多组学队列组装成本高昂且难以共享，这促使合成队列作为补充资源。随着生成模型发展加速，我们将焦点从提出又一种架构转向定义评估标准，以判定合成数据是否保留生物学相关结构。我们引入一个生物学信息驱动且患者不相交的框架，用于评估配对 RNA 表达和拷贝数变异（CNV）谱的生成，并将其应用于纵向 DECIDER 高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。该框架以真实训练数据与留出数据之间的一致性为参考，评估模态特异性保真度以及 RNA 与 CNV 配对之间的连贯性，同时辅以训练数据邻近性诊断。我们改编了三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构来生成配对谱。在若干保真度和连贯性指标上领先的模型也表现出最强的训练数据邻近性。该方案和案例研究为社区提供了比较未来多组学生成器的参考。

items.title_en: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
items.title_zh: 论预填充到自回归跨模型迁移的机遇与挑战
items.abstract_en: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. However, controlled experiments show that the gains on some tasks can be reproduced by uninformative sender signals, self-communication, or receiver-only training. We find that trainable bridges can act as parameter-efficient adaptation mechanisms without exploiting useful sender information. We therefore propose PACT-Check to quantify how much of a trained PACT system's gain genuinely comes from communication. Finally, we discuss the opportunities and challenges of PACT systems. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour.
items.abstract_zh: 预填充到自回归跨模型迁移（PACT）是一种语言模型之间的潜在通信形式，它将较大模型的提示表示与较小模型的高效生成相结合，为平衡能力与推理成本提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，现有系统对独立评估大小模型协作的支持有限，而且仅凭任务性能提升并不能确定接收方是否从发送方信息中受益。我们提出 PLatour，一个开源 PACT 框架，通过轻量级、零初始化且直接使用任务奖励训练的线性桥连接冻结模型，并支持混合注意力架构。PLatour 在生成任务上显著优于开源基线，并在共享数学和编码基准上使用小得多的发送方超过了 Mostik 报告的结果。然而，受控实验表明，某些任务上的增益可以通过无信息的发送方信号、自我通信或仅接收方训练来复现。我们发现，可训练桥可以作为参数高效的适配机制，而无需利用有用的发送方信息。因此，我们提出 PACT-Check，以量化训练后的 PACT 系统增益中有多少真正来自通信。最后，我们讨论 PACT 系统的机遇与挑战。代码见 https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour。

items.title_en: ZipDrift: Generating Multimodal Short-Horizon MPC Costs with One-Step Drifting Models
items.title_zh: ZipDrift：使用一步漂移模型生成多模态短时域 MPC 代价
items.abstract_en: Short-horizon model predictive control (MPC) is fast but myopic. ZipMPC compensates by learning a context-dependent correction of the short-horizon cost that imitates a long-horizon expert. We observe that the optimal correction is often multimodal: when a slower opponent can be passed on either side, good corrections of opposite sign coexist, and the expert's choice between them hinges on tiny cost differences. Deterministic regression then averages modes or inherits inconsistent expert tie-breaking. We propose ZipDrift, which trains a one-step drifting generator over MPC cost corrections, tilted toward low closed-loop cost and learned only from cost evaluations of candidate corrections, without differentiating through the optimiser. A few generated candidates are ranked by a learned critic, and the model-based MPC then enforces dynamics and constraints. In a kinematic overtaking benchmark derived from ZipMPC, more than half of the contexts are bimodal and the manual short-horizon MPC crashes in 28% of them. With an eight-dimensional stagewise correction, evaluated on 1000 fresh contexts and five training seeds, ZipDrift with eight candidates crashes in 0.74% of episodes, compared with 3.4% for an idealised ZipMPC-style regressor and 2.1% for critic-ranked random candidates with the same budget. A mixture density network (MDN) with the same selection is equally good (0.76%). The benefit of drifting lies in sample quality: in a pre-specified test on further unseen contexts, a single drifting sample crashes in 8.7% of episodes against 13.2% for the MDN, and ZipDrift needs four candidates instead of eight to fall below 1%. With many candidates, all methods degrade as selection exploits errors of the critic.
items.abstract_zh: 短时域模型预测控制（MPC）速度快但目光短浅。ZipMPC 通过学习模仿长时域专家的、依赖于上下文的短时域代价校正来进行补偿。我们观察到，最优校正通常是多模态的：当较慢的对手可以从任一侧超越时，符号相反的良好校正会共存，而专家在它们之间的选择取决于微小的代价差异。确定性回归会平均模式，或继承专家不一致的平局决策。我们提出 ZipDrift，它在 MPC 代价校正上训练一步漂移生成器，偏向低闭环代价，并且仅从候选校正的代价评估中学习，而不通过对优化器求导。若干生成的候选由学习到的评论家排序，然后基于模型的 MPC 执行动力学和约束。在由 ZipMPC 导出的运动学超车基准中，超过一半的上下文是双峰的，而手动短时域 MPC 在其中 28% 的情况下发生碰撞。使用八维逐阶段校正，在 1000 个新上下文和五个训练种子上评估，具有八个候选的 ZipDrift 在 0.74% 的回合中发生碰撞，而理想化的 ZipMPC 风格回归器为 3.4%，相同预算下由评论家排序的随机候选为 2.1%。采用相同选择的混合密度网络（MDN）同样好（0.76%）。漂移的优势在于样本质量：在进一步未见上下文上的预先设定测试中，单个漂移样本在 8.7% 的回合中发生碰撞，而 MDN 为 13.2%，并且 ZipDrift 需要四个而不是八个候选即可降至 1% 以下。当候选很多时，所有方法都会退化，因为选择会利用评论家的误差。

items.title_en: Agent-Driven Generative Priors for Pathology Image Synthesis and Segmentation
items.title_zh: 智能体驱动的生成先验用于病理图像合成与分割
items.abstract_en: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.
items.abstract_zh: 病理深度学习方法受限于大规模像素级标注的可得性有限且成本高昂。合成数据可以缓解这一限制，但现有流程往往缺乏可靠的质量控制，且与下游分析联系较弱。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个三阶段框架，集成自动数据筛选、生成式表征学习以及对下游任务的高效适配。首先，我们开发病理智能体系统来评估图像质量并过滤样本，得到 TCGA-200K，这是一个包含从公共 TCGA 仓库中选出的 217,030 个病理图像块的数据集。其次，我们在筛选后的数据上训练生成模型。除图像合成外，其骨干网络还学习可迁移至下游任务的结构与语义表征。第三，我们使用轻量级任务专用头将预训练生成骨干适配到语义分割。我们进一步引入 PathSeg-380K，这是一个语义分割数据集，包含对 12 种细胞类型约 380,000 个细胞的专家标注。在多个病理数据集上的实验表明，所提框架取得了最先进的分割性能。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Structural Variant Detection in Whole-Exome Sequencing of 67 Multiple Myeloma Cell Lines
items.title_zh: 对 67 个多发性骨髓瘤细胞系全外显子组测序中结构变异检测的基准评估
items.abstract_en: Background. Although the majority of structural variant (SV) workflows have been derived based on whole genome sequencing (WGS) data, they continue to be applied to whole exome sequence (WES) data for which many studies have evaluated their performance in cancer. An equally important consideration that has not been well studied is the impact of cancer context specific features among WGS-derived SV callers applied to WES data. Similar to personalized medicine, not all SV callers are alike and optimal for use with all cancer types and sequence data types. In addition to sequencing related data features, cancer types have embedded features withing the sequencing data that should be considered. Herein, we performed an analysis of SV heterogeneity among WGS-derived SV callers to WES data in multiple myeloma (MM), a cancer known for its genetically heterogeneous nature. Using WES data derived from a panel of 67 Multiple Myeloma (MM) cell lines, we evaluated seven WGS-derived SV detection tools (Delly, SvABA, BreakDancer, Smoove, LUMPY and Manta) for their ability to identify cytogenetically known genetic abnormalities and to characterize overall differences in the number, length, type, and runtime of SVs called among them. Results. Among the seven tools, Smoove and Manta both had the shortest runtime, processing files in less than 2 minutes, in contrast to tools that required more than two hours to run such as SvABA and Pindel. Smoove was the only SV caller to identify a range of SV types, while SvABA was the most restrictive, calling only breakends. All tools differed in the length of SVs called, with SvABA's unfiltered output including the shortest length of less than 10 base pairs (bps), and Delly and BreakDancer's output including the longest, with SVs of less than 1,000 bps. At the chromosome level, SvABA's unfiltered output and Delly's output included 78% and 27.5% of known SVs, respectively, with the remaining tools (including SvABA's filtered output) achieved recall rates of less of less than 10%. By comparison, at the genomics coordinate level, no tool identified more than 20% of known SVs. Conclusions. As all evaluated SV detection tools achieved poor recall rates on this comprehensive catalog of MM cell lines, this study implies SVs detected by WGS-based SV callers on WES data should be confirmed experimentally before being declared legitimate. Heterogeneity in these tools' output lends support to their combined use in practice. Considering that many clinical grade sequencing panels continue to expand their repertoire of rearrangements with therapeutic implications, our results prompt the potential need for cancer type-matched workflows to evaluate the calling of such rearrangements.
items.abstract_zh: 背景。尽管大多数结构变异（SV）流程是基于全基因组测序（WGS）数据开发的，但它们仍被应用于全外显子组测序（WES）数据，许多研究已评估其在癌症中的性能。另一个同样重要但尚未得到充分研究的问题是，将基于 WGS 的 SV 调用器应用于 WES 数据时，癌症背景特异性特征的影响。与个性化医疗类似，并非所有 SV 调用器都相同，也并非都最适合所有癌症类型和序列数据类型。除测序相关数据特征外，癌症类型在测序数据中还具有应考虑的嵌入特征。本文中，我们分析了多发性骨髓瘤（MM）中将基于 WGS 的 SV 调用器用于 WES 数据时的 SV 异质性；MM 是一种以遗传异质性著称的癌症。使用来自 67 个多发性骨髓瘤（MM）细胞系面板的 WES 数据，我们评估了七种基于 WGS 的 SV 检测工具（Delly、SvABA、BreakDancer、Smoove、LUMPY 和 Manta）识别细胞遗传学已知遗传异常的能力，并刻画它们在所调用 SV 的数量、长度、类型和运行时间方面的总体差异。结果。在七种工具中，Smoove 和 Manta 的运行时间最短，处理文件不到 2 分钟，而 SvABA 和 Pindel 等工具则需要超过两小时。Smoove 是唯一能识别一系列 SV 类型的 SV 调用器，而 SvABA 限制性最强，仅调用断裂末端。所有工具所调用 SV 的长度均不同，SvABA 未过滤输出包含最短长度小于 10 个碱基对（bp），Delly 和 BreakDancer 的输出包含最长的 SV，即小于 1,000 bp 的 SV。在染色体水平上，SvABA 的未过滤输出和 Delly 的输出分别包含 78% 和 27.5% 的已知 SV，其余工具（包括 SvABA 的过滤后输出）的召回率均低于 10%。相比之下，在基因组坐标水平上，没有工具识别出超过 20% 的已知 SV。结论。由于所有评估的 SV 检测工具在这一全面的 MM 细胞系目录上召回率均较差，本研究表明，基于 WGS 的 SV 调用器在 WES 数据上检测到的 SV 应在被认定为真实之前进行实验确认。这些工具输出的异质性支持在实践中联合使用它们。考虑到许多临床级测序面板持续扩展其具有治疗意义的重排检测范围，我们的结果提示可能需要癌症类型匹配的工作流来评估此类重排的调用。

items.title_en: Room-Temperature Quantum Emission from Boron Nitride Nanotubes
items.title_zh: 氮化硼纳米管的室温量子发射
items.abstract_en: Quantum information systems such as quantum key distribution and quantum communications require bright, high-purity, stable sources of single photons to act as carriers of quantum information. As such, methods for obtaining single photon emitters (SPEs) in solid-state devices capable of articulating with quantum photonic circuits are a necessary obstacle that must be overcome. Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) flakes have been extensively studied as a host material for SPEs, though working in two dimensions is accompanied by engineering complexity. However, dimensionality can be reduced through the implementation of boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs). Here we investigate the potential of BNNTs as room-temperature SPEs using confocal photoluminescence microscopy and Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometry. Quantum emitters were found in BNNTs spanning the entirety of the visible spectrum, including spectral regions where SPEs within hBN have not been reported. Furthermore, each tube was found to possess multiple SPEs at varying emission wavelengths along the length, exhibiting lifetimes as fast as 0.5 ns, which is about two-fold faster than the fastest hBN SPEs. Additionally, we demonstrate that surface passivation/coating mitigates blinking events, therefore increasing the emitter stability. Thus, BNNTs can function as a single structure supporting a variety of multiwavelength SPE sources, while maintaining a compact radius of ~25 nm, making them ideally suited for deterministic placement and integration within nanophotonic devices such as waveguides and interferometric filters.
items.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发和量子通信等量子信息系统需要明亮、高纯度、稳定的单光子源作为量子信息的载体。因此，在能够与量子光子电路耦合的固态器件中获得单光子发射器（SPE）的方法，是必须克服的必要障碍。六方氮化硼（hBN）薄片已作为 SPE 的宿主材料得到广泛研究，不过在二维体系中工作伴随工程复杂性。然而，通过采用氮化硼纳米管（BNNT）可以降低维度。本文中，我们利用共聚焦光致发光显微术和 Hanbury Brown-Twiss 干涉术研究 BNNT 作为室温 SPE 的潜力。在 BNNT 中发现了覆盖整个可见光谱的量子发射器，包括 hBN 中尚未报道 SPE 的光谱区域。此外，每根管沿长度方向在不同发射波长处具有多个 SPE，寿命最快可达 0.5 ns，约为最快的 hBN SPE 的两倍快。另外，我们证明表面钝化/涂层可减轻闪烁事件，从而提高发射器稳定性。因此，BNNT 可作为支持多种多波长 SPE 源的单根结构，同时保持约 25 nm 的紧凑半径，使其非常适合确定性放置并集成到波导和干涉滤光器等纳米光子器件中。

items.title_en: When Less is More: Emerging Network-Wide Use Cases for Hollow-Core Fibers in Optical Networks [Invited]
items.title_zh: 少即是多：空芯光纤在光网络中的新兴网络级用例 [特邀]
items.abstract_en: Hollow-Core Fiber (HCF) is emerging as a disruptive technology for next-generation optical networks, offering 30\% lower propagation latency than standard Single-Mode Fiber (SMF), record-low attenuation (0.05-0.1 dB/km), and nonlinearities reduced by three to four orders of magnitude. While the physical-layer benefits of HCF have been extensively demonstrated, recent industrial commitments by hyperscalers (e.g., Microsoft, Amazon) and the rapid maturation of nested antiresonant nodeless fibers (NANF) call for a systematic assessment of the impact of HCF at the network level. Building on a series of prior contributions, we overview four emerging network-wide use cases for the selective deployment of HCF in hybrid SMF/HCF networks: (i) latency-constrained Edge Data Center (edgeDC) consolidation; (ii) energy-efficient high-power amplification; (iii) capacity scaling via single-fiber bidirectional (BiDi) transmission; and (iv) coexistence of classical and quantum (QKD) channels. Consolidated results across realistic metro, national, and continental topologies convey a unifying message: in each use case, a selective HCF upgrade captures a significant share of the achievable benefit compared to a network overhaul. The required HCF budget is use-case-specific, i.e., 6-24\% of the total network fiber length for edgeDC consolidation (up to 50\% fewer edgeDCs), 40\% of the network links for QKD/classical coexistence (up to 38\% fewer quantum modules), and 40-60\% of the network links for energy-efficient capacity scaling via BiDi-HCF (up to 28\% lower network power per Tbps and 70\% more served traffic, at half the HCF strand count of a unidirectional HCF upgrade), whereas for energy-efficient high-power amplification the gain keeps growing with the HCF budget (up to 60\% lower network power per Tbps at the national scale) and what saturates is the benefit of increasing the EDFA output power.
items.abstract_zh: 空芯光纤（HCF）正成为下一代光网络的颠覆性技术，其传播时延比标准单模光纤（SMF）低 30%，衰减达到创纪录的低水平（0.05-0.1 dB/km），非线性降低三到四个数量级。虽然 HCF 的物理层优势已被广泛证明，但超大规模厂商（如 Microsoft、Amazon）近期的产业投入以及嵌套反谐振无节点光纤（NANF）的快速成熟，要求系统评估 HCF 在网络层面的影响。基于一系列先前工作，我们概述在混合 SMF/HCF 网络中选择性部署 HCF 的四个新兴网络级用例：(i) 时延受限的边缘数据中心（edgeDC）整合；(ii) 节能的高功率放大；(iii) 通过单纤双向（BiDi）传输实现容量扩展；(iv) 经典与量子（QKD）信道共存。跨现实城域、国家和洲际拓扑的综合结果传达了一个统一信息：在每个用例中，与网络全面改造相比，选择性 HCF 升级可获得可实现收益的显著份额。所需 HCF 预算因用例而异，即 edgeDC 整合需占总网络光纤长度的 6-24%（edgeDC 最多减少 50%），QKD/经典共存需占网络链路的 40%（量子模块最多减少 38%），通过 BiDi-HCF 实现节能容量扩展需占网络链路的 40-60%（每 Tbps 网络功耗最多降低 28%，服务流量增加 70%，且 HCF 纤芯数为单向 HCF 升级的一半），而对于节能的高功率放大，增益随 HCF 预算持续增长（在国家尺度上每 Tbps 网络功耗最多降低 60%），而趋于饱和的是提高 EDFA 输出功率所带来的收益。

items.title_en: Cultural Adaptation within Repeated Social Interactions
items.title_zh: 重复社会互动中的文化适应
items.abstract_en: Much of human culture is tacit and is typically learned through situated social interaction. As LLMs are deployed as interactive agents across diverse communities, assessing their cultural competence demands moving beyond existing question-answering approaches, shifting from what they know to how they adapt. In this work, we broaden the scope of cultural adaptation in NLP by investigating whether LLMs can adapt through repeated interactions via a sandbox environment. By reframing cultural adaptation as a continuous process of norm assimilation through social interaction, our work demonstrates that memory mechanisms foster longitudinal learning across repeated interactions, facilitate transfer to different social settings, and enable multilingual norm assimilation across five languages. Together, our findings lay the groundwork for continuous, interaction-driven cultural adaptation in LLMs.
items.abstract_zh: 人类文化很大一部分是隐性的，通常通过情境化社会互动习得。随着 LLM 作为交互式智能体部署于不同社区，评估其文化能力要求超越现有问答方法，从它们知道什么转向它们如何适应。在本工作中，我们通过沙盒环境研究 LLM 能否在重复互动中适应，从而拓宽 NLP 中文化适应的范围。通过将文化适应重新定义为通过社会互动进行规范同化的连续过程，我们的工作表明，记忆机制促进跨重复互动的纵向学习，促进向不同社会环境的迁移，并实现跨五种语言的多语言规范同化。总之，我们的发现为 LLM 中连续的、互动驱动的文化适应奠定了基础。

items.title_en: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
items.title_zh: OdorSpaces：三维环境中的视觉-嗅觉具身导航
items.abstract_en: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. Experiments show that the policy outperforms a diverse set of baselines, establishing a strong reference for future research on visual-olfactory embodied navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 嗅觉提供关于空气传播化学线索的关键信息，但在具身 AI 中仍很大程度上未被充分探索，先前机器嗅觉工作有限，主要集中于语义气味感知。我们引入 OdorSpaces，一个基于物理的仿真平台和视觉-嗅觉具身导航基准。OdorSpaces 通过由火灾动力学模拟器（FDS）模拟的三维气味传输与扩散来增强 Habitat-Sim，使智能体能够利用视觉和嗅觉观测在逼真室内环境中导航。该基准包括两个代表性寻源场景：不可见气体泄漏定位和早期火灾定位。我们开发了一个初始多模态强化学习策略，随时间整合视觉观测和嗅觉测量。实验表明，该策略优于多种基线，为未来视觉-嗅觉具身导航研究建立了有力参考。

items.title_en: Adaptive Low-Light Enhancement for Road Anomaly Detection: A Multi-Architecture Benchmark and Edge Deployment Study
items.title_zh: 面向道路异常检测的自适应低光照增强：多架构基准测试与边缘部署研究
items.abstract_en: Road anomaly detection systems on autonomous vehicles must function reliably under degraded visual conditions including darkness, rain, and Harmattan dust haze. This paper benchmarks four object detection architectures, YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n, RT-DETR, and Faster R-CNN, under physically grounded lighting and weather degradation, and shows that uniform application of the SCI low-light enhancement network is actively harmful at dusk-level lighting (-16.1% to -30.7% mAP@50). We propose a lightweight, training-free luminance-adaptive router that selects between no enhancement, moderate SCI, and denoising plus strong SCI based on per-frame Rec. 601 luminance, recovering most of the dusk penalty while preserving low-light gains, and we validate the full pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson Nano edge hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶车辆上的道路异常检测系统必须在包括黑暗、降雨和哈马丹尘雾等退化视觉条件下可靠运行。本文在基于物理的光照与天气退化条件下对四种目标检测架构——YOLOv8n、YOLOv12n、RT-DETR 和 Faster R-CNN——进行基准测试，并表明统一应用 SCI 低光照增强网络在黄昏级光照下反而有害（mAP@50 下降 16.1% 至 30.7%）。我们提出一种轻量、免训练的亮度自适应路由器，基于逐帧 Rec. 601 亮度在无增强、中等 SCI 以及去噪加强 SCI 之间进行选择，在保留低光照增益的同时挽回大部分黄昏性能损失，并在 NVIDIA Jetson Nano 边缘硬件上验证了完整流程。

items.title_en: Agentic Pipeline for Large-Scale Clinical Data Queries in Enterprise Electronic Health Records
items.title_zh: 面向企业电子健康记录大规模临床数据查询的智能体流水线
items.abstract_en: Using electronic health record (EHR) data to answer clinical research questions is challenging. It requires understanding the research question, finding relevant information across different sources, and combining that information to produce meaningful results. We developed an agentic large language model (LLM) pipeline that decomposes investigator-authored requests into source-specific tasks, generates and executes SQL on EHR, integrates structured and unstructured EHR evidence, and applies study-specific clinical note adjudication. We evaluated this workflow against data analyst-identified cohorts across 50 pediatric orthopedic clinical data query requests. Of these, 43 were included in manual-review-adjusted performance analyses. The median adjusted positive predictive value, sensitivity among patients identified by either approach, and corresponding F1 score were 0.93 (95% CI, 0.88-0.98), 0.92 (95% CI, 0.90-0.95) and 0.90 (95% CI, 0.87-0.94), respectively. These findings support the feasibility of translating natural-language research intent into executable, autonomous multi-stage EHR workflows.
items.abstract_zh: 使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据回答临床研究问题具有挑战性。这需要理解研究问题、在不同来源中查找相关信息，并整合这些信息以产生有意义的结果。我们开发了一种智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线，将研究者撰写的请求分解为针对特定来源的任务，在 EHR 上生成并执行 SQL，整合结构化与非结构化 EHR 证据，并应用研究特定的临床记录裁定。我们在 50 个儿科骨科临床数据查询请求上，将该工作流与数据分析师识别的队列进行对比评估。其中 43 个被纳入经人工复核调整的性能分析。调整后的阳性预测值中位数、在任一方法识别患者中的敏感性以及相应 F1 分数分别为 0.93（95% CI，0.88–0.98）、0.92（95% CI，0.90–0.95）和 0.90（95% CI，0.87–0.94）。这些发现支持将自然语言研究意图转化为可执行、自主的多阶段 EHR 工作流的可行性。

items.title_en: Quantum enhanced beam displacement estimation: sensitivity limits, optimal probes, and measurement schemes
items.title_zh: 量子增强光束位移估计：灵敏度极限、最优探针与测量方案
items.abstract_en: We investigate the ultimate sensitivity limits for measuring small transverse beam displacements and identify optimal strategies that attain them, using the framework of mode parameter estimation. We contrast two families of states with different resource constraints, using Hermite-Gauss and Laguerre-Gauss mode pairs. First, for fixed total photon number states, the optimal state is identified and we show that it asymptotically approaches a rotated NOON state. The sensitivity bound is compared to that of an asymptotically optimal pure Gaussian state with fixed average photon number. Finally, we propose concrete measurement schemes using the method of moments and show that the twin-Fock state may provide a viable alternative to the rotated NOON state for this task. Our work provides a broader benchmark for developing practical strategies for spatial sensing at the quantum limit.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究测量微小横向光束位移的最终灵敏度极限，并在模式参数估计框架下确定达到这些极限的最优策略。我们使用 Hermite-Gauss 和 Laguerre-Gauss 模式对，对比了两类具有不同资源约束的态。首先，对于固定总光子数的态，识别出最优态，并表明它渐近趋近于旋转 NOON 态。将该灵敏度界与具有固定平均光子数的渐近最优纯高斯态的灵敏度界进行比较。最后，我们提出使用矩方法的具体测量方案，并表明双 Fock 态可能为该任务提供旋转 NOON 态的可行替代方案。我们的工作为在量子极限下开发空间传感的实用策略提供了更广泛的基准。

items.title_en: SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization
items.title_zh: SAE 解释 MoE：稀疏自编码器揭示 MoE 专家具有人类可解释的细粒度专业化
items.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many experts, yet what an individual expert is responsible for remains unsettled. Existing analyses count how often an expert is selected on domain-labeled corpora, an instrument that fixes the taxonomy in advance, stays coarse, and records selection rather than contribution. We instead study specialization in feature space by training a sparse autoencoder (SAE) on the output of an MoE layer. Since this output is a router-weighted sum of expert outputs and the SAE encoder is affine, the pre-activation of every latent decomposes exactly over the experts. Aggregated over a corpus, this gives each expert a dominant set of latents whose activation it principally drives. On layers 4, 30 and 46 of Qwen3-30B-A3B, contribution is far more concentrated than gating, most latents have only one or two dominators, and the overlap between dominant sets concentrates on a few expert pairs. Auto-interpreting these sets reveals a division of labor below coarse domains, with distinct experts for Java and front-end web code, or for geometry and for arithmetic and polynomials, while the coarse domains themselves take very unequal numbers of experts. Our SAEs and code are available at https://github.com/Bytedance-Seed/SAE-Interprets-MoE.
items.abstract_zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型将每个 token 路由到众多专家中的少数几个，但单个专家负责什么仍未有定论。现有分析统计专家在领域标注语料上被选中的频率，这种工具预先固定分类体系、粒度较粗，且记录的是选择而非贡献。我们改为通过在 MoE 层输出上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），在特征空间中研究专业化。由于该输出是专家输出的路由器加权和，且 SAE 编码器是仿射的，每个潜变量的预激活可精确分解到各专家上。在语料上聚合后，这为每个专家给出一组由其主导激活的主导潜变量集合。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的第 4、30 和 46 层上，贡献远比门控更集中，大多数潜变量只有一个或两个主导专家，主导集合之间的重叠集中在少数专家对上。自动解释这些集合揭示了粗粒度领域之下的分工，例如 Java 与前端网页代码由不同专家负责，几何与算术及多项式由不同专家负责，而粗粒度领域本身占用的专家数量非常不均衡。我们的 SAE 与代码见 https://github.com/Bytedance-Seed/SAE-Interprets-MoE。

items.title_en: Polarity Classification with Multitask Learning Syntax Augmentation
items.title_zh: 基于多任务学习句法增强的极性分类
items.abstract_en: Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental NLP task concerned with the identification and categorization of subjective information in text. While lexicon-based methods offer transparency, they often struggle with linguistic phenomena such as negation and intensification. Syntactic parsing has been integrated into SA pipelines to address this, but conventional parsers introduce significant computational overhead. Recent work shows that reformulating dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task can improve efficiency. We propose and compare two strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model under unified Multi-Task Learning (MTL). The first, Standard-MTL, jointly learns dependency parsing (via sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification using a shared encoder with two task-specific heads. The second, Contrastive-MTL, provides implicit syntactic guidance through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax-biased attention pooling mechanism, without requiring explicit label prediction. Both rely on syntactic annotations during training and eliminate need for hand-crafted compositional rules or external parsing at inference. We evaluate eleven datasets spanning seven languages---the MARC corpus (English, Spanish, French, German) and seven datasets from SemEval-2022 Task 10 (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, Catalan)---using four established SEL encodings. With the relative encoding, Contrastive-MTL outperforms a syntax-naive baseline on 10 of 11 datasets and surpasses the external rule-based pipeline (SELSP) that parses at inference on all six datasets where the latter applies, while being 1.5--9$\times$ faster at evaluation. Standard-MTL is more dataset- and encoding-dependent. These results show implicit syntactic supervision during training can match or exceed explicit parsing at inference without computational overhead.
items.abstract_zh: 情感分析（SA）是一项基础 NLP 任务，涉及识别和归类文本中的主观信息。基于词典的方法具有透明性，但往往难以处理否定和强化等语言现象。句法分析已被整合到 SA 流水线中以应对这一问题，但传统解析器会带来显著的计算开销。近期工作表明，将依存句法分析重构为序列标注（SEL）任务可以提高效率。我们提出并比较了在统一多任务学习（MTL）下将句法知识集成到神经情感分析模型中的两种策略。第一种 Standard-MTL 使用共享编码器和两个任务特定头，联合学习依存句法分析（通过序列标注）和情感极性分类。第二种 Contrastive-MTL 通过对比辅助目标和句法偏置的注意力池化机制提供隐式句法指导，无需显式标签预测。两者在训练时均依赖句法标注，并消除了推理时对手工组合规则或外部解析的需求。我们使用四种成熟的 SEL 编码，在涵盖七种语言的 11 个数据集上评估——MARC 语料（英语、西班牙语、法语、德语）以及 SemEval-2022 Task 10 的七个数据集（英语、西班牙语、挪威语、巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语）。在相对编码下，Contrastive-MTL 在 11 个数据集中的 10 个上优于无句法基线，并在后者适用的全部六个数据集上超过推理时解析的外部规则流水线（SELSP），同时在评估时快 1.5–9 倍。Standard-MTL 更依赖数据集和编码方式。这些结果表明，训练期间的隐式句法监督可以在不增加计算开销的情况下达到或超过推理时的显式解析。

items.title_en: A Multimodal Haptic Interface for Simultaneous Softness and Thermal Modulation
items.title_zh: 用于同时调节柔软度与温度的多模态触觉界面
items.abstract_en: Haptic interactions, such as touching an object in virtual reality, involve detecting a plethora of sensations through the skin. Whilst tactile displays exist to simulate and manipulate all of these cues individually, little progress has been made constructing devices that can control multiple cues simultaneously. This paper presents a tactile display technology that offers both softness and temperature change. A prototype display, based on particle jamming and the thermal transfer of heated and cooled water, is evaluated in terms of its ability to change both stiffness and temperature. Mechanical evaluations demonstrate controllable stiffness increase of 300%, whilst thermal characterisation showed strong surface uniformity and a range of achievable temperatures from 10°C up to 50°C, with closed-loop control maintaining a 0.2°C error from a setpoint. This work advances the design of multimodal tactile displays with applications to perceptual research, medical simulation, and affective haptics.
items.abstract_zh: 触觉交互，例如在虚拟现实中触摸物体，涉及通过皮肤检测大量感觉。尽管已有触觉显示器可单独模拟和操控所有这些线索，但在构建能同时控制多种线索的设备方面进展甚少。本文提出一种同时提供柔软度和温度变化的触觉显示技术。基于颗粒阻塞以及加热和冷却水的热传递的原型显示器，就其改变刚度和温度的能力进行了评估。力学评估表明刚度可控制地增加 300%，热表征则显示出很强的表面均匀性以及从 10°C 到 50°C 的可实现温度范围，闭环控制相对设定点保持 0.2°C 误差。这项工作推进了多模态触觉显示器的设计，可应用于感知研究、医学模拟和情感触觉。
